what: `tracking-issue-summary.sh` upsert preconditions disagree across plan sections
scenario_or_breakage: Step 6 only gates on `ISSUE_NUMBER` plus non-empty body; later text adds `PLAN_WRITE_OK` for upsert. If implementers require `PLAN_WRITE_OK=true`, many post–Step-0a exits never set that variable (`skills/design/SKILL.md` only assigns it in Step 5c), so GitHub upserts could be skipped on clarify or plan-size cancels while chat still renders, contradicting Round-1 “emit on ALL post–Step-0a exits” if that includes GitHub.
suggested_fix: Make upsert rules explicit in one place: either document that GitHub upsert is intentionally Step-5-only, or gate with `!= false` or a dedicated `SUMMARY_UPSERT_OK` flag; align NEW `render-final-summary.sh` steps with `skills/design/SKILL.md` ordering prose.

what: Duration sourcing for `/design` is named but not wired
scenario_or_breakage: Plan passes `--duration <elapsed-from-timing-ledger>` into `render-run-summary.sh` without saying which file or helper produces it. `/implement` reads `larch-logs/implement/<RUN_ID>/timing-report.json`; `/design` often has no `larch-logs/design/<RUN_ID>/` until `design-log-publish.sh`, and cancel paths skip publish entirely.
suggested_fix: Specify the authoritative duration probe (e.g. `timing-report.sh --format json --output "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/timing-report.json"` best-effort, parse like `write-final-report.sh`, or document `N/A` when no JSON exists) and add a harness fixture for the no-publish path.

what: `--exec-issues` and `--warnings` numeric contract not derived from listed artifacts
scenario_or_breakage: Renderer requires integer counts; plan only says compose bullet text from `execution-issues.md`. Markdown sections from `append-tool-failure.sh` do not match `write-final-report.sh`’s `execution-issues.ndjson` grep strategy.
suggested_fix: Wire a deterministic counter (reuse `append-execution-issue.sh` metadata if present, or `grep -c` on stable section headers or `**Step` entries) and document it beside the `render-run-summary.sh` invocation in the new helper spec.

what: `test-design-structure.sh` anchor risks conflicting with encapsulated upsert
scenario_or_breakage: Plan requires `skills/design/SKILL.md` to mention both `render-final-summary.sh` and `tracking-issue-summary.sh upsert-summary`, while the NEW helper is supposed to own upsert internally. CI could force duplicate upsert instructions or fail if SKILL only references the helper.
suggested_fix: Anchor the script name actually invoked from SKILL (single entrypoint) or assert cross-reference via a stable string inside `skills/design/scripts/render-final-summary.sh` instead of requiring a second upsert callout in SKILL.

what: Step 17 failure tail still steers orchestrator to removed chat token summary

Removing the block without rewriting this branch invites halt or double emission if an agent follows the surviving prose.
